title: THE REC MARK SHOWS THE TIME
why: The F9 recorder (v21.18) stops by itself after 3 minutes, but its red REC mark gave no time, so the stop could come as a surprise. It now reads REC 1:05 / 3:00 as it goes. It is a page element, so it is never in the clip.
now: While recording with F9, the REC mark shows how long you have recorded out of 3 minutes.
